rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person travelling to a sacred place or taking part in a religious pilgrimage.

example.english: This pilgrim went to Mecca on a pilgrimage.
example.traditional: 呢位朝聖者去咗麥加朝聖。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 ciu4 sing3 ze2 heoi3 zo2 mak6 gaa1 ciu4 sing3

rows.note: Use this for a religious pilgrim visiting a temple, shrine, or other place of worship, especially in a Chinese context.

example.english: A pilgrim comes to this temple on the first day of every lunar month.
example.traditional: 初一都有香客嚟呢間廟。
example.jyutping: co1 jat1 dou1 jau5 hoeng1 haak3 lei4 ni1 gaan1 miu6

rows.note: Use this only when the broad sense of pilgrim is simply a traveller, without emphasis on religion or a pilgrimage.

example.english: The pilgrim asked for directions at the station.
example.jyutping: go3 leoi5 haak3 hai2 ce1 zaam6 man6 lou6

rows.note: Use this in the historical context of the early American Pilgrim settlers, who are commonly described as 清教徒.

example.english: A pilgrim sailed to North America to settle.
example.traditional: 有個清教徒坐船去北美定居。
example.jyutping: jau5 go3 cing1 gaau3 tou4 zo6 syun4 heoi3 bak1 mei5 ding6 geoi1
